teaser: Six in the morning, a rental car eats the highway, and you already have the radio tuned and both hands loose on the wheel. You are a 3 who reads as ESTP: the life path built for the voice that lights a room, set inside a temperament built to clock a room before deciding what to say in it. The number asks for expression; these letters supply the nerve and the timing. Together the charm arrives fast, unrehearsed, aimed at whoever is in front of you right now — which is the gift and also the thing nobody downstream of this moment gets to plan around.
excerpt: Three text messages go unanswered because the evening got good and you didn't want to leave it to check a phone.
